item.name: Live Streams

description.content:
A Live Stream represents a unique live stream of video being pushed to Mux. It includes configuration details (a Stream Key) for live broadcasting software/hardware and a Playback ID for playing the stream anywhere. Currently, RTMP is the only supported method of ingesting video. Use rtmp://global-live.mux.com:5222/app with the Live Stream's Stream Key for getting the video into Mux, and use https://stream.mux.com with the Live Stream's Playback ID for playback.

A Live Stream can be used once for a specific event, or re-used forever. If you're building an application like Facebook Live or Twitch, you could create one Live Stream per user. This allows them to configure their broadcasting software once, and the Live Stream Playback ID will always show their latest stream.

Each RTMP session creates a new video asset automatically. You can set up a webhook to be notified each time a broadcast (or Live Stream RTMP session) begins or ends with the video.live_stream.active and video.live_stream.idle events respectively. Assets that are created from a Live Stream have the same behavior as other Assets you create.

Learn more about [how to go live in our guides](https://docs.mux.com/guides/start-live-streaming).

item.name: Create a Live Stream

description.content: Creates a new live stream. Once created, an encoder can connect to Mux via the specified stream key and begin streaming to an audience.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: List Live Streams

description.content: Lists the live streams that currently exist in the current environment.

query.description: Number of items to include in the response
Offset by this many pages, of the size of `limit`
Filter response to return live stream for this stream key only
Filter response to return live streams with the specified status only

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Retrieve a Live Stream

description.content: Retrieves the details of a live stream that has previously been created. Supply the unique live stream ID that was returned from your previous request, and Mux will return the corresponding live stream information. The same information is returned when creating a live stream.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Delete a Live Stream

description.content: Deletes a live stream from the current environment. If the live stream is currently active and being streamed to, ingest will be terminated and the encoder will be disconnected.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Update a Live Stream

description.content: Updates the parameters of a previously-created live stream. This currently supports a subset of variables. Supply the live stream ID and the updated parameters and Mux will return the corresponding live stream information. The information returned will be the same after update as for subsequent get live stream requests.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Create a Live Stream Playback ID

request.name: Create a Live Stream Playback ID

description.content: Create a new playback ID for this live stream, through which a viewer can watch the streamed content of the live stream.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Retrieve a Live Stream Playback ID

request.name: Retrieve a Live Stream Playback ID

description.content: Fetches information about a live stream's playback ID, through which a viewer can watch the streamed content from this live stream.

variable.description: (Required) The asset or live stream's playback ID.
(Required) The asset or live stream's playback ID.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Delete a Live Stream Playback ID

request.name: Delete a Live Stream Playback ID

description.content: Deletes the playback ID for the live stream. This will not disable ingest (as the live stream still exists). New attempts to play back the live stream will fail immediately. However, current viewers will be able to continue watching the stream for some period of time.

variable.description: (Required) The asset or live stream's playback ID.
(Required) The asset or live stream's playback ID.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Reset a Live Stream's Stream Key

request.name: Reset a Live Stream's Stream Key

description.content: Reset a live stream key if you want to immediately stop the current stream key from working and create a new stream key that can be used for future broadcasts.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Signal a Live Stream Is Finished

request.name: Signal a Live Stream Is Finished

description.content:
(Optional) End the live stream recording immediately instead of waiting for the reconnect_window. `EXT-X-ENDLIST` tag is added to the HLS manifest which notifies the player that this live stream is over.

Mux does not close the encoder connection immediately. Encoders are often configured to re-establish connections immediately which would result in a new recorded asset. For this reason, Mux waits for 60s before closing the connection with the encoder. This 60s timeframe is meant to give encoder operators a chance to disconnect from their end.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Disable a Live Stream

description.content:
Disables a live stream, making it reject incoming RTMP streams until re-enabled. The API also ends the live stream recording immediately when active. Ending the live stream recording adds the `EXT-X-ENDLIST` tag to the HLS manifest which notifies the player that this live stream is over.

Mux also closes the encoder connection immediately. Any attempt from the encoder to re-establish connection will fail till the live stream is re-enabled.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Enable a Live Stream

description.content: Enables a live stream, allowing it to accept an incoming RTMP stream.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Update a Live Stream's Embedded Subtitles

request.name: Update a Live Stream's Embedded Subtitles

description.content:
Configures a live stream to receive embedded closed captions.
The resulting Asset's subtitle text track will have `closed_captions: true` set.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Update a Live Stream's Generated Subtitles

request.name: Update a Live Stream's Generated Subtitles

description.content:
Updates a live stream's automatic-speech-recognition-generated subtitle configuration.
Automatic speech recognition subtitles can be removed by sending an empty array in the
request payload.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Create a Live Stream Simulcast Target

request.name: Create a Live Stream Simulcast Target

description.content: Create a simulcast target for the parent live stream. Simulcast target can only be created when the parent live stream is in idle state. Only one simulcast target can be created at a time with this API.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Delete a Live Stream Simulcast Target

request.name: Delete a Live Stream Simulcast Target

description.content: Delete the simulcast target using the simulcast target ID returned when creating the simulcast target. Simulcast Target can only be deleted when the parent live stream is in idle state.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the simulcast target.
(Required) The ID of the simulcast target.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Retrieve a Live Stream Simulcast Target

request.name: Retrieve a Live Stream Simulcast Target

description.content: Retrieves the details of the simulcast target created for the parent live stream. Supply the unique live stream ID and simulcast target ID that was returned in the response of create simulcast target request, and Mux will return the corresponding information.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the simulcast target.
(Required) The ID of the simulcast target.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Update Live Stream Static Renditions for New Assets

request.name: Update Live Stream Static Renditions for New Assets

description.content: Updates a live stream's static renditions settings for new assets. Further assets made via this live stream will create static renditions per the settings provided. You must provide all static renditions desired.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Delete a Live Stream's Static Renditions Setting for New Assets

request.name: Delete a Live Stream's Static Renditions Setting for New Assets

description.content: Deletes a live stream's static renditions settings for new assets. Further assets made via this live stream will not create static renditions unless re-added.
Added as a part of security scheme: basic
